## LaTeX formula compatibility

These examples define the LaTeX delimiter surface recognized by the `formula`
extension alongside the dollar delimiter surface.

```````````````````````````````` example
Inline \\(x+y\\) end.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Inline " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:8..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal="x+y" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:17..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" end." children=0
````````````````````````````````

Single-backslash LaTeX-looking delimiters are ordinary Markdown escapes, not
formula delimiters.

```````````````````````````````` example
Inline \(x+y\) end.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Inline (x+y) end." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Display \\[x+y\\] end.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Display " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:9..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} mode=standalone literal="x+y" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:18..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" end." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Display \[x+y\] end.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Display [x+y] end." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
\\[x+y\\]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── FormulaBlock scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x+y" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
\\[
x+y
\\]
.
Document scope=1:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── FormulaBlock scope=1:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x+y" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Display formula blocks bind before Markdown block syntax inside the body.

```````````````````````````````` example
\\[
\\nabla \\times \\boldsymbol{E}
=
-\\frac{\\partial \\boldsymbol{B}}{\\partial t}
\\]
.
Document scope=1:1..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── FormulaBlock scope=1:1..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\\\\nabla \\\\times \\\\boldsymbol{E}\n=\n-\\\\frac{\\\\partial \\\\boldsymbol{B}}{\\\\partial t}" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Text $$x+y$$ end.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Text " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:6..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} mode=standalone literal="x+y" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:13..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" end." children=0
````````````````````````````````

Dollar display formula blocks bind before Markdown block syntax inside the body.

```````````````````````````````` example
$$
\\nabla \\times \\boldsymbol{E}
=
-\\frac{\\partial \\boldsymbol{B}}{\\partial t}
$$
.
Document scope=1:1..5:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── FormulaBlock scope=1:1..5:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\\\\nabla \\\\times \\\\boldsymbol{E}\n=\n-\\\\frac{\\\\partial \\\\boldsymbol{B}}{\\\\partial t}" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Escaped backslash closers are body text, not delimiters.

```````````````````````````````` example
Text \\(a \) b\\) end.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Text " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:6..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal="a ) b" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:18..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" end." children=0
````````````````````````````````

When a body contains the matching backslash delimiter, render with dollar
delimiters so LaTeX does not close early.

```````````````````````````````` example
Text $a\\)b$ end.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Text " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:6..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal="a\\\\)b" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:13..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" end." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Text $$a\\]b$$ end.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Text " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:6..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} mode=standalone literal="a\\\\]b" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:15..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" end." children=0
````````````````````````````````

Q18's padding rule applies to the backslash forms exactly as it does to the
dollar ones: a body that begins and ends with a space or a line ending loses one
from each end, and nothing else moves. No oracle row covered this, which is why
these two are pinned here.

```````````````````````````````` example
Inline \\( x \\) and \\(  y  \\).
.
Document scope=1:1..1:33 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:33 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Inline " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:8..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal="x" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:17..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" and " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:22..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal=" y " children=0
    └── Text scope=1:33..1:33 anchor=null attributes={} literal="." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Display \\[
z
\\] end.
.
Document scope=1:1..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Display " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:9..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} mode=standalone literal="z" children=0
    └── Text scope=3:4..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" end." children=0
````````````````````````````````
